The '''''Valorous''''' was a [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 short hauler]] in service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], it delivered [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]], [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]], and two [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] to [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]].<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref>
